apps.name: JetGlass
apps.subtitle: Liquid Glass plane spotter
apps.localizedDescription: JetPhotos + FlightRadar24 in a liquid-glass iOS 26 app. Live map with airline labels and ICAO airport search, photo search and downloads via jetapi.dev.
apps.versionDescription: Real plane icon (SF Symbol) that rotates with each aircraft heading, replacing the emoji. Pull the info card down for more info: extra photos, Mode S, serial, operator, recent flight history and the JetPhotos source link.
